purpose: Teach: むかし/みち/帰ら/叩き/割っ/削り/好か/きらい

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、むかしのおもちゃ、お家に置いてるの
lines.en: Sho, do you remember — I used to keep old toys at my place.
lines.style: Soft, almost to herself. Gentle nostalgia in the phrasing. Slight upward lift on his name — checking he's listening. Warm but distant, like remembering something precious she can't quite hold.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、メイ姉さんのお店までのみち、覚えたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I remembered the way to your store.
lines.style: Bright, eager to report. Light attack on the first syllable. Pride without showiness — genuine accomplishment in a small thing. Eyes up, seeking her approval.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは今夜、お仕事で帰らないらしいわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad won't be home tonight — he's got work.
lines.style: Casual, matter-of-fact delivery, but the pause before 'tonight' carries weight. Not alarming, just letting him know. Watching his face for how he takes it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ピアノを叩きすぎちゃったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I was playing the piano too hard.
lines.style: Small, self-aware. The slightest rueful edge — not quite ashamed, but noticing his own intensity. Quiet exhale. Looking for her reaction without begging for reassurance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お皿を割って、悲しい気持ちにならないでね
lines.en: Sho, don't feel sad just because you broke a dish, okay?
lines.style: Tender and steady. Low, close voice — the kind of thing you say when you're looking at someone directly. Not dismissing the feeling, but gently redirecting. Patient, like she's said this before and will say it again.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと鉛筆を削りに机に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I went to sharpen pencils at the desk.
lines.style: Warm, straightforward reporting. Small bright note in the middle of a quiet sentence. He's sharing something ordinary that mattered to him. Open, trusting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達に好かれるのは大事よ
lines.en: Sho, it's important to be liked by your friends.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not lecturing — more like offering him something she's learned. Measured pace. The kind of thing said once, carefully, meant to stay with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お薬きらいだけど飲むよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I don't like medicine but I'll take it.
lines.style: Soft resolve. No complaint in it, just honest acknowledgment. Small pause before 'but' — the turning point where he commits. Voice doesn't rise or fall dramatically, just steady and true.
